item.title: She Had No Filter During This Interview
item.description: A few innocent questions quickly lead to some very unexpected answers during this Tokyo street interview. From dating stories to an unusual drawing reveal, the conversation gets more unpredictable by the minute.

item.title: Her Celebrity Crush Put Him in an Awkward Position
item.description: A conversation about celebrity crushes gets awkward when she reveals just how much she loves Harry Styles. Her boyfriend seems supportive at first, but the hypothetical questions quickly take the interview in an unexpected direction.
